message.content: {"quality": false, "reason": "The candidate skill 'Resolve Forced-Choice Pathology via Exhaustive Phrase Grounding' is functionally identical to the existing neighbor skill s_5367798970bef205 ('Resolve Ambiguous Pathology via Report-Guided Grounding').
